licence.note: The licence page requires a link to Open-Meteo next to any location its data are displayed. Free API access is offered for non-commercial use; this dataset is a committed offline snapshot and the simulation contacts no weather service at runtime.

notes: These are RECORDED daily values for Saint Lucia. They are the only non-synthetic physical input to the saint-lucia-demo-v1 scenario. Every actor, farm, buyer, order, yield, price and outcome built on top of them remains SYNTHETIC.
A recorded weather day is evidence about the weather. It is never evidence that a Harvest delivery, order, commitment or outcome occurred.
Values are daily aggregates from a numerical model grid cell, not point observations from an instrument at the named place. A passing squall is smoothed into a modest daily figure at this resolution.

Across all six station-years in this file the highest daily maximum 10 m wind speed is 24.6 km/h and only one day exceeds 20 mm of rain. That is a property of daily gridded reanalysis over a small island, not evidence that Saint Lucia has calm Septembers; September is peak Atlantic hurricane season and none of these three windows contained a hurricane strike on the island.

The `models` parameter was left at its default (`best_match`). Open-Meteo may change what Best Match resolves to, so a refresh is not guaranteed to reproduce these values byte for byte. Pinning `models=era5` gives a stable but coarser (0.25 degree) alternative that disagrees with the values here: for 2025-09-01 at the primary station it reports 2.1 mm against 1.0 mm.
ERA5-Land returns null over both requested points because they fall on coastal or ocean cells, so no ERA5-Land-only variant of this file is possible.
The scenario runs a 2026 calendar window against records from 2023, 2024 and 2025. Days are matched on month-and-day, never on year; the year is chosen deterministically from the run seed.

source.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API - daily aggregates, Hewanorra International Airport, Vieux Fort, 1-22 September 2023
source.publisher: Open-Meteo.com (Zippenfenig, P., 2023), reanalysis input from the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)

reference.geography: Saint Lucia's WMO synoptic reporting site (Hewanorra International Airport, UVF/TLPL), on the island's southern tip. Requested at 13.73N 60.95W; the API answered from the nearest model grid cell, whose centre is recorded in `grid`. A grid cell is not a rain gauge: the value is an area mean, not a point observation. Model grid cell centre 13.813708, -60.965088 at 4 m. Local calendar days, timezone America/St_Lucia (GMT-4).
